scope: Primary research and practitioner sources for a six-action PF2e tactical planner

sources.title: Evolutionary MCTS with Flexible Search Horizon
relevance: turn-based games with several atomic actions per turn
cross-turn horizons with fast behavior models

sources.title: Combining Utility AI and MCTS Towards Creating Intelligent Agents in Video Games, with the Use Case of Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift
relevance: hierarchical combination of strategic utility and tactical search
playing strength and believability as separate evaluation goals

sources.title: Tactical Position Selection
relevance: candidate generation, filtering and weighted evaluation
normalized criteria, upper bounds and debugging

sources.title: Modular Tactical Influence Maps
relevance: area spells, tank positioning, spacing and safe withdrawal

sources.title: Three States and a Plan: The AI of F.E.A.R.
SquadSmart: Hierarchical Planning and Coordinated Plan Execution for Squads of Characters
relevance: sensed effects, plan failure and re-planning

sources.title: Asymmetric Action Abstractions for Multi-Unit Control in Adversarial Real-Time Games
Guiding Monte Carlo Tree Search by Scripts in Real-Time Strategy Games
Real-Time Planning as Decision-Making under Uncertainty
relevance: commitment to the next action under a fixed planning budget

recommendation.horizon: Current own turn, abstract opponent/ally response, next own turn
recommendation.spatialModel: Named normalized influence layers combined by role-specific tactical position queries
recommendation.execution: Execute one native action, observe, repair or re-plan
recommendation.firstBackend: Deterministic beam or weighted best-first search; retain MCTS as a later experimental backend
